tagline: 理光便携相机，1993 年发布
description: 理光于1993年推出的便携相机。配备Ricoh Lens 34mm f/4.5, 3 elements in 3 groups。快门速度1/50 sec. and 1/100 sec.。感光度ISO 100 or 400 (DX-Code system)。Single-point active autofocusing system。

specs.镜头: Ricoh Lens 34mm f/4.5, 3 elements in 3 groups
specs.英文简介: The AF-77S is a point-and-shoot camera for 35mm film, introduced by Japanese manufacturer Ricoh in 1993.
